Provides a resource to create a APM sample config

## Example Usage

<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="javascript,typescript">

```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const example = new tencentcloud.apm.Instance("example", {
    name: "tf-example",
    description: "desc.",
    traceDuration: 7,
    spanDailyCounters: 0,
    tags: {
        createdBy: "Terraform",
    },
});
const exampleSampleConfig = new tencentcloud.apm.SampleConfig("example", {
    instanceId: example.id,
    sampleName: "tf-example",
    sampleRate: 90,
    serviceName: "java-order-serive",
    operationType: 0,
    tags: [{
        key: "createdBy",
        value: "Terraform",
    }],
});
```

<div>
<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="go">

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/apm"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		example, err := apm.NewInstance(ctx, "example", &apm.InstanceArgs{
			Name:              pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			Description:       pulumi.String("desc."),
			TraceDuration:     pulumi.Int(7),
			SpanDailyCounters: pulumi.Int(0),
			Tags: pulumi.StringMap{
				"createdBy": pulumi.String("Terraform"),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = apm.NewSampleConfig(ctx, "example", &apm.SampleConfigArgs{
			InstanceId:    example.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			SampleName:    pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			SampleRate:    pulumi.Int(90),
			ServiceName:   pulumi.String("java-order-serive"),
			OperationType: pulumi.Int(0),
			Tags: apm.SampleConfigTagArray{
				&apm.SampleConfigTagArgs{
					Key:   pulumi.String("createdBy"),
					Value: pulumi.String("Terraform"),
				},
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}
```
</pulumi-choosable>

package generated_program;

import com.pulumi.Context;
import com.pulumi.Pulumi;
import com.pulumi.core.Output;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Apm.Instance;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Apm.InstanceArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Apm.SampleConfig;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Apm.SampleConfigArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Apm.inputs.SampleConfigTagArgs;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);
    }

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        var example = new Instance("example", InstanceArgs.builder()
            .name("tf-example")
            .description("desc.")
            .traceDuration(7)
            .spanDailyCounters(0)
            .tags(Map.of("createdBy", "Terraform"))
            .build());

        var exampleSampleConfig = new SampleConfig("exampleSampleConfig", SampleConfigArgs.builder()
            .instanceId(example.id())
            .sampleName("tf-example")
            .sampleRate(90)
            .serviceName("java-order-serive")
            .operationType(0)
            .tags(SampleConfigTagArgs.builder()
                .key("createdBy")
                .value("Terraform")
                .build())
            .build());

    }
}

## Import



APM sample config can be imported using the instanceId#sampleName, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Apm/sampleConfig:SampleConfig example apm-jPr5iQL77#tf-example
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
